primary: W0 R1; R2/R3/R4 predeclared secondary, best-arm choice acknowledged as selection

calibration.mapping_error: not pure NWP error; includes power-mapping and operating effects
calibration.historical_weather: forecast issued at least 15min before origin; availability checked; 26/7809 train and 32/8146 validation predecessor nodes use endpoint hold

controls.R1_RAWMAP: same six-dimensional summary, raw power replaces residual statistics
controls.R1_SELF: delayed target residual summary on retained N3 base
controls.R2_PAIR: same parameters; residual slots zero, p and mapped power retained, same information
controls.R3_RAW: same spatial rings/projection; only raw power slots active
controls.C1: matched R1/R2/R3/R4 architectures, neighbor observed p replaced with mapped power
controls.C2: matched architectures, joint power/weather donors from another 2022 day with matching month and clock; synthetic year distribution shift is a limitation

summary: capacity-weighted mean, cross-neighbor standard deviation, one-hour mean change; R1 adds residual and mapping statistics to N3; R3/R4 also include raw statistics and ring presence

neighbors.direction: R4 only; smooth attenuated trigonometric residual terms, no travel-time prior

training.selection: same MAE-selected checkpoint for both primary metrics; separate RMSE selection supplementary

gate.high_power: current CF>=0.7, equal seed within farm then equal farm

reporting: raw farm/seed results; equal seeds within farm then equal farm means; report horizon/lead and strata, including losses
interventions: fixed-weight sensitivity; residual-only edits violate r=p-m and are not causal proof

ARX.method: multi-task elastic net, l1_ratio=0.8, 24 direct target deltas
ARX.input: own 24 history, seven forecast snapshots plus SEL, all 150km-neighbor last four delayed observations; RAW adds power, RES residual, PAIR power and mapping

storage: no predictions/attention arrays; <=2 selected neural checkpoints, one compact ARX coefficient archive per farm; delete successful resume and verified remote duplicates
next: review all gates then separately freeze 2024; previous B1 remains deferred
